A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same D3M study. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C are readable and can be matched across the extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v3 reports original D3M experiments on UCI Heart Disease, CIFAR-10/10.1, Camelyon17, and GEMINI, together with quantitative appendix ablations.

after.justification: v4 retains these original benchmark and clinical-data experiments, including the ablations and Two Moons experiment in Appendix C.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains the Train–Calibrate–Deploy procedure, feature extractor and VBLL architecture, ELBO objective, posterior and categorical sampling, and disagreement-quantile detection rule.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same datasets and tasks, including GEMINI temporal and age-mixture shifts and the Two Moons experiment. No training or evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains BBSD, Relative Mahalanobis, Deep Ensemble, CTST, MMD-D, H-Div, and Detectron. Comparator membership in the GEMINI plots and appendix comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendix B retain the same reported splits, preprocessing, metrics, query sizes, model configurations, hyperparameters, and testing procedures. Figure 2(a)'s revised axes do not change the evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Appendix C retains the same head comparison, computational-cost analysis, temperature and threshold studies, oversampling analysis, and fully Bayesian comparison, including the Two Moons illustration.

E5.justification: Both retain mean and standard deviation reporting over ten seeded runs. Appendix B.5 preserves the seed procedure, repeated test sampling, and rule of collecting ten runs satisfying the ID FPR threshold.

E6.justification: The numerical results in Table 2 and Tables 7–12, along with the plotted findings, are unchanged. Figure 2(a) preserves all eight AUROC values and its reference line despite changes to tick spacing and legend text.

T1.justification: Appendix A retains Definitions 1–6, Algorithms 1–2, and the same assumptions, theoretical statements, derivations, and proofs. Equation-rendering differences are typesetting changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about label-free monitoring, independence from training data during deployment, scalability, and conditional FPR/TPR guarantees.

C2.justification: The discussions of noisy small-query estimates, oversampling beyond the ideal hypothesis space, deterministic-label assumptions, failure regimes, and clinical integration are retained without substantive revision.

D1.justification: Section 2.4 and Appendix B retain the stated code access, implementation details, hyperparameters, sweeping procedures, hardware requirements, and runtime information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Numbered citations replace author-year citations, and some bibliographic URLs disappear, without adding or removing cited research.

P1.justification: v4 adds acknowledgments and funding disclosures, updates the author block, changes citation style, and removes the stray phrase 'Two core limit' from Section 2.4. The scientific prose and section sequence remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: The NeurIPS template changes typography, margins, spacing, and figure/table scaling and placement throughout. Figures 2–3 and Tables 5–6 now share pages. Figure 2(a) is restyled, including changing 'Baseline performance' to 'Training data', while preserving its data.

improvement.justification: The added funding disclosure and removal of stray and duplicated text modestly improve transparency and editorial polish. Scientific support and limitations remain unchanged, while smaller plot lettering, particularly in Figure 2(a), limits the presentation benefit.
